title: Read a PDF
summary: Downloads a PDF and returns its text page by page; scanned pages are read with on-device OCR.
whenToUse: Use when the person points at a PDF (a paper's full text, a report, a form) and wants what is in it.

arguments.name: url
arguments.description: The PDF's address, such as https://arxiv.org/pdf/2410.15285

example: Read the PDF at https://arxiv.org/pdf/2410.15285 and summarize its method
